name: macterm-website
description: Marketing site and docs for Macterm — built by Bun, served by Caddy.

scripts.fetch: git clone --filter=blob:none --no-checkout https://github.com/macterm/macterm.git macterm && git -C macterm sparse-checkout set --no-cone /assets/ /Macterm/Info.plist /scripts/publish-appcast.sh && git -C macterm checkout main
scripts.build: bun run build:assets && bun run build:img && bun run build:docs && bun run build:css && bun run check:seo && bun run check:feed
scripts.dev: bun releases.mjs && bun run build && bun run serve
scripts.podman:build: bun lastmod.mjs && bun releases.mjs && podman build --format docker --platform linux/arm64 -f Containerfile -t macterm-website .
